messages:
carmen: Heads-up — publish CI for `js-sdk` failed on release candidate after automated regen. The regen reordered an overload so `createUser(id, opts?)` became `createUser(opts?, id)` in the generated typings. Bundle builds but runtime auth middleware breaks because the interceptor expects token arg at position 1. Repro: `yarn regen && yarn workspace js-sdk build && yarn test:smoke sample-app` — smoke fails with `TypeError: token is undefined`.

lee: Oof. Was the package version bumped? That will trigger the release flow.

carmen: Yes — package.json went 2.0.0 -> 2.1.0 in the autogen PR. typegen-bot created PR #8123 (autogen/typegen-3201234567). release-bot marked it for publish.

drew: If regen-only changes bump public surface semver we should require an explicit maintainer sign-off. Otherwise we end up shipping accidental API churn. Proposals: 1) disallow package.json version changes in bot PRs unless a `maintainer/approve-semver` label exists, 2) add a small test in our SDK CI that instantiates generated client and runs a real auth-retry flow against the sample auth stub.

carmen: I prefer both. Quick patch: revert runtime interceptor to look up token by header name instead of positional index. I'll open a hotfix PR. But long-term we need CI gates and a typegen lint rule that flags public-signature reorders.

typegen-bot: Generated diff summary for 3201234567: 4 files modified (openapi client + typings + package.json + changelog). Suggested semver: minor.

lee: We also need a changelog hygiene rule: regen-driven version bumps must include a human-written changelog entry explaining the intent. If it's accidental, the entry should be "regen: non-behavioral reorder — reverting to maintain compatibility" or similar. publishflow should reject publish without that.

carmen: Hotfix PR #8124 opened to revert positional header lookup in auth interceptor. Running sample-app smoke locally. Will add a unit test that fails if interceptors assume arg positions.

drew: Also, let's add a pre-merge GitHub check that compares public API surface (quick AST diff) and if there's a change, require a `typegen:api-change` label and a changelog entry. We can keep the bot's suggested semver but block automatic publish until label+changelog present.

release-bot: publishflow blocked for PR #8123 — missing CHANGES entry. Automated check: `regen-only-version-bump` flagged.

carmen: Local smoke passed after revert. I'll mark PR #8124 WIP and ask for two reviewers. After merge we'll re-run regen with adjusted typegen config to stabilize overload ordering and add acceptance test in sample-app CI.

lee: Great. Add a short note to the devex runbook about this pattern and steps to take when typegen mutates public signatures. Also consider a pre-regen dry-run to detect signature shuffles and warn authors.

carmen: Will draft the runbook entry and post here when ready. Thanks all for the quick help.
